crossRefs.note: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:
All Israel, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests, who…
Afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, according to all that is written in the book of…
When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said…
She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me…
Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.
She named him Joseph, saying, “May Yahweh add another son to me.”
As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

translations.web: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
translations.bsb: “When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
translations.kjv: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:
translations.asv: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are passed over the Jordan: Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin.
